skills.title: Skills
skills.disabledHint: Ask an administrator to enable Skills for your account in User Management.
skills.scanDone: Scan done: {{imported}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{skipped}} skipped
skills.importOverwriteConfirm: Overwrite skills with the same name if they exist? (Cancel to skip duplicates)
skills.empty: No skills yet. Create one or place SKILL.md under skills/ and click Scan disk.
skills.emptyFiltered: No skills match the current filters.
skills.scopeTitle: Chat scopes (inject skill catalog/inline body when checked)
skills.scopeHint: Requires both Use in AI chat and the matching scope.
skills.slashHint: Type /name in chat to force-load this Skill (defaults to the skill id). Use {{arg}} / $ARGUMENTS / {{arg1}} for args after the slash.
skills.hooksHint: Edit hooks.json below (preToolUse / postToolUse / postToolUseFailure / sessionStart / sessionEnd / beforeMCPExecution, decision: allow/deny/ask/eval). Fail-open by default.
skills.hooksJsonHint: Events: preToolUse / postToolUse / postToolUseFailure / sessionStart / sessionEnd / beforeMCPExecution. decision = allow/deny/ask. Clear and save to delete the file.
skills.commandsHint: Add commands/alias.md under the skill folder; chat /alias loads that file (supports {{arg}}). Refresh the form after saving files on disk.
skills.allowedToolsHint: Empty = no limit; e.g. ssh_execute,list_hosts,*channel*. After this Skill loads, only matching tools may run.
skills.slashMenuHint: Type / to filter and pick a command, then enter args
skills.slashParamsGuide: Selected {{slash}}. Keep typing args after the command; they replace {{hint}} in the skill body.
skills.slashParamsSendHint: Send when ready; args are optional.
skills.contentHint: Cursor format: frontmatter name, description (third-person WHAT+WHEN), disable-model-invocation (default true). Keep SKILL.md concise; put details in reference.md. Use /id in chat; placeholders {{arg}}.
skills.groupsEmpty: No custom groups yet (new skills default to Ungrouped).
skills.groupsHint: Deleting a group moves its skills to Ungrouped.
skills.moveToGroupHint: Choose a target group (your skills only).
skills.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete group "{{name}}"? Skills in this group will move to Ungrouped.

slashParamsPickHint: Click a suggestion below, or keep typing; ←→ / ↑↓ select · Enter to fill
slashParamsNoSuggestions: No built-in arg suggestions (add a “Commands/Usage” list or slash-args in SKILL.md)
